'''House Borgin''' was one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the head of the House was [[Rodas Borgin]], the [[Duke of Serenno]]. He was eventually replaced by his young son, [[Pero Borgin|Pero]], when he was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
